turns.text: ok wait boss i need a menu flyer for lola's roll, its for the counter at heron & grind. my phone is cracked and basically dead so i need something i can finish fast 🥢
Happy to help! Let me get the essentials so you can wrap this up quickly: what's on the menu, what's the price, and any line you want on it?
main thing is lumpiang shanghai with pork and shrimp, comes with sweet chili and spiced vinegar dips. name is Lola's Roll and i want a little line that its named for my grandmother
Lovely. Do you have a price in mind? Also, do you want a contact or Instagram handle on it?

price is the thing lol. i checked joan's commissary this afternoon, its $28 an hour with a 3 hour minimum so i need the price to actually cover that. thinking $10 for a half dozen? also gotta ask beatrice if i can put it by the counter, hopefully she says yes 🔥

Quick math: the 3-hour minimum at $28 an hour is $84 for kitchen time alone, before wrappers, pork and shrimp. At $10 per half dozen you'd need to sell about 9 half dozens (roughly 50 lumpia) just to cover the kitchen. So $10 works if you're making a decent batch, and it leaves room for ingredients if you go bigger. Here's the flyer:

[Image: A warm cream flyer with a hand-drawn stack of golden lumpia at the top. Large red headline: "Lola's Roll". Subtitle in smaller script: "Named for my grandmother, made with her love." Center: "Lumpiang Shanghai, pork & shrimp, crispy-fried." Below, two small dip icons labeled "Sweet chili" and "Spiced vinegar". A bold price badge: "$10 / half dozen". Bottom strip: "Ask at the counter!" with space for your Instagram handle.]

It's simple enough to print as is. When you ask your boss about the counter spot, I can also write a short, friendly note for her.
ok actually can you make the grandmother line warmer and shorter. battery is at like 3%
Done: [Image: Same flyer, with the subtitle changed to "Named for my Lola, made with love." in a softer script, everything else unchanged.] Save it now before your battery dies!
